title: Read files at a revision with git cat-file in factdiff.py and kbgit.py
goal: factdiff.calibrate_history, kbgit.show and kbgit cmd_asof read a file at a revision with git cat-file blob REV:PATH, never git show REV:PATH; a TestRevisionReadsWithoutGitShow class in test_factdiff.py and in test_history.py drives each reader with a runner that fails every git show REV:PATH as Filename too long (as TestHeldOnLongPaths in test_querylog_e2e.py does for ql_deliver) and asserts the content is still read.

run: import re,pathlib;hits=[f for f in ('_tools/factdiff.py','_tools/kbgit.py') if re.search(r'"show", f"\{', pathlib.Path(f).read_text(encoding='utf-8'))];assert not hits,hits
